Clears the biggest hurdle; increases deal-closure odds and reduces uncertainty.
Next binary catalyst; a no vote could derail or delay the deal.
Sets expected consideration; informs dilution and capital impact for CBAN.
Provides timing for synergy realization and integration risk.
Scale jump could improve efficiency and market positioning in the Southeast.
